//: The CommonJS build. `module: node16` with `"type": "commonjs"` in
package.json emits require()/exports, and — unlike the old `moduleResolution:
node` — it resolves the way Node 20 actually does, so an import that would
fail at runtime fails at compile time instead.
The output stays at dist/ root: that is what `main`, `types`, every existing
`require("astra-plugin-sdk")` and CI's tarball check already point at.
